proposals.name: The Hedgerow
proposals.why: A hedgerow is many wild, unmatched things growing side by side and holding one another up, which is what these eighteen guardians are, and it is the smell I want every design to carry.

proposals.name: Physic Garden
proposals.why: A physic garden was the bed where healing herbs were grown by hand, each one different and all tended for the same cure, and that is how I see a panel of guardians who disagree and still make one thing well.

proposals.name: Garden Almanac
proposals.why: An almanac is a plain book kept season by season, truthful about what grew, and the panel's record of its decisions should read the same way.
